items.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I saw some of the early ones and enjoyed learning so much about Louis Armstrong. A lot of stuff I didn’t really know.

ctx.x: You know I didn’t see that whole documentary. I saw some of the early ones and enjoyed learning so much about Louis Armstrong. A lot of stuff I didn’t really know. So I was really pleased and I saw that as a big plus. From talking to my musical colleagues that apparently he left the last 50 years of music history for an hour and a half segment, I didn’t even end up finishing it so I can’t comment on the sweep of the whole work. I guess in his defense he never pretended that this was supposed to be a definitive…
